description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Server_Fault, which extends Zend_XmlRpc_Fault to encapsulate and manage XML-RPC fault responses, including handling specific exception classes, observers, and fault instances.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Server_Fault
classes.description: A class that extends Zend_XmlRpc_Fault to represent XML-RPC fault responses, with additional handling for specific exception classes, observers, and fault information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new fault object based on a provided exception, sets fault code and message, and notifies observers.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create and retrieve an instance of Zend_XmlRpc_Server_Fault from an exception.

methods.name: attachFaultException
methods.description: Adds exception classes that are recognized as valid for generating XML-RPC faults.

methods.name: detachFaultException
methods.description: Removes exception classes from the recognized list for fault generation.

methods.name: attachObserver
methods.description: Add an observer class that will be notified of fault events.

methods.name: detachObserver
methods.description: Remove an observer class from the notification list.

methods.name: getException
methods.description: Retrieves the exception associated with this fault instance.
